sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Algonac State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-20, 2027-06-08 and 2027-07-13; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-25)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site (2027-06-08 and 07-13 alike): 20/30-amp electric-only sites $37, 30-amp full-hookup sites $47, 50-amp full-hookup sites $52; 2026 (Oct 20): $35 / $45 / $50. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park and forest campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule (Riverfront North/South: $37 for 92 electric-only sites, $47 for 18 and $52 for 110 full-hookup sites on 2027-06-08 and 2027-07-13; $35 / $45 / $50 on 2026-10-20) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/algonac ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/algonac (Riverfront: 'There is 30- or 50-amp service available on portion of sites', 'Full-hookup sites') + midnrreservations.com site attributes (110 sites 'Electric & Water, Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps, Sewer Hookup=Yes'; 18 with 20/30 A, water and sewer; 92 'Electric Only' 20/30 A), read 2026-10-25

values.note: North and south loops; mostly generous, level sites on gravel pads; two ADA sites. The full-hookup sites are in the north section, which has no shared restrooms or showers. On the booking site 202 sites take trailers/RVs to 50 ft (110 'over 50''), the 18 30-amp full-hookup sites to 40 ft.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/algonac ('The modern campground has 220 sites in the north and south loops', 'A majority of sites have gravel pads', 'Pull-through sites available') + midnrreservations.com resources (equipment to 'Trailer or RV over 50'' on 110 sites, 'up to 50'' on 92, 'up to 40'' on 18), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/algonac (Algonac Modern Riverfront: 'Concession or store', 'Sanitation station', 'Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet'; 'the north section of the campground features full hookup sites, meaning there are no shared restrooms or showers in that area'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/algonac (Algonac Modern Riverfront: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-25

note: Open, grassy sites along the park's half-mile St. Clair River frontage. A through-road runs between the front sites and the river; freighter-watching is the draw. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site: 220 sites in north/south loops, 20/30 A electric-only (92), 30 A full hookup (18) and 50 A full hookup (110), pull-throughs, RVs to 50+ ft, showers/flush and vault toilets/sanitation station, store. Fees 30-40 (old table) -> 37-52 (2027 booking site; 2026 $35-50 and the Recreation Passport in fees.note). Season (manual, year-round with reservable window) left. Inherited window/15-night max not stated on the park page. Already split from Wagon Wheel. Note trimmed of what the fields hold.
